about: The film's timing in one place. tools/build.py puts it into the picture, and tools/sfx_track.py and tools/guide_track.py read it, so moving a moment here moves the drawing, its sound and its music hit together.
from / to: the shot's first frame and the frame after its last (24 fps). Each cut sits one frame before a beat of the music (audio/beats.json).
moments: seconds from the start of the shot. t is one time or a list of times (usually start and end). The names are the constants the shot's code uses.
space: the acoustic space of the shot (see SPACES in tools/sfx_track.py).

shots.name: Top hat
shots.summary: A gust takes a gentleman's hat; he catches it on the umbrella tip, spins it and flicks it back onto his head.

T_OFF.what: the gust lifts the hat off the gentleman's head

T_SEAT.what: the hat drops onto the umbrella tip

T_SPIN.what: he spins it on the tip

T_FLICK.what: he flicks it back towards the gentleman

T_HEAD.what: it lands on the gentleman's head (he flinches)

T_SIP.what: sip: cup starts up, at the mouth, (still drinking at the cut)

shots.name: Scooter
shots.summary: A kid on a scooter, eyes on his phone, heads for a lamppost; one tap on the handlebar and he curves round it at full speed.

T_TAP.what: the umbrella tip taps the handlebar

T_POCKET.what: the phone goes into his pocket

shots.name: Postman
shots.summary: A dog barks through the letterbox and the postman's letters fly; the tip juggles them into the slot, one, two, three.

T_SLIP.what: the bark: the flap bangs open, the postman jolts, the letters slip out of his hand

T_POPS.what: each time the tip pops a letter back up

T_SLOTS.what: each letter tapped into the slot (the flap snaps shut ~0.28 s later)

shots.name: Pigeon
shots.summary: A pigeon's dropping falls for his head; he taps it into a planter, and some of it stays on the tip.

T_HIT.what: the dropping meets the umbrella tip

shots.name: Flowerpot
shots.summary: The dirty tip saves a falling pot (leaving a smear on it); the pigeon poops on a man reading on a bench, and gets it flicked straight back.

T_LAND.what: the pigeon lands on the sill

T_REL.what: it lets go over the reader

T_SPLAT.what: flicked back: it hits the pigeon

shots.name: Butcher
shots.summary: He wipes the tip clean on his own trouser leg; a bulldog steals a chain of sausages; one chop, one snip, and the falling sausage ends up skewered on the tip.

T_WIPE.what: one swipe down his own shin: the tip is clean

T_HOOK.what: he lifts the chain off the dog

T_TURN.what: the dog turns and digs in

T_GRAB.what: the butcher grabs the far end: tug of war

T_SPEAR.what: the falling sausage is skewered on the tip

T_SIP.what: sip: up, at the mouth, leaves the mouth, down

shots.name: Cat
shots.summary: The sausage on the tip coaxes a cat out of a tree and into a girl’s hands.

T_UP.what: the tip with the sausage rises to the cat

T_DOWN.what: the tip lowers, the cat following it with its eyes

T_WIPE.what: he wipes scrap and grease onto the girl's palm

T_JUMP.what: the cat jumps down to her hand (then purrs and licks her palm)

T_SIP.what: sip: up, at the mouth, leaves the mouth, (half way down at the cut)

shots.name: Pond
shots.summary: Snapping the umbrella open is the gust that fills a becalmed toy boat's sails.

T_GUST.what: the gust reaches the sails; the kids are surprised, then cheer from T_GUST + 0.25

T_SIP.what: sip: up, at the mouth, leaves the mouth, down

T_DIP.what: unused gag, parked after the end of the shot: dip the canopy in the pond

T_POUR.what: unused gag: pour the water out

shots.name: Wet concrete
shots.summary: He hooks the crook over a scaffold rail and glides over the fresh concrete, knees up, coffee level.

T_TOSS.what: tosses it and catches it low

T_RAISE.what: raises the crook to the rail (the hop)

T_HOOK.what: the crook hooks the rail: clang

T_LAND.what: feet down on the far side

T_SLIDE.what: the shaft slides through his hand to the crook

shots.name: Ice cream
shots.summary: A dropped cone and two gold coins flicked into the tip jar.

T_FALL.what: both scoops topple onto the pavement

C1.what: the first coin flies into the jar

TR1.what: the vendor carries the first fresh scoop

C2.what: the second coin flies into the jar

T_MAKE.what: the vendor makes the girl's cone

T_SIP.what: sip: up, at the mouth, leaves the mouth, (partly down at the cut)

shots.name: Painter
shots.summary: He flicks a painter's lost glasses back onto his nose.

T_REACH.what: the tip slides under the glasses

T_ON.what: they land on the painter's nose; he startles

S_CLK.what: the clock face (the real clock strikes at its end)

T_SIP.what: sip: up, at the mouth, leaves the mouth, down

shots.name: Van
shots.summary: He taps a sliding box back into the van and slides its door shut.

T_CLIMB.what: the driver climbs into the cab on the far side

T_ENG.what: the engine catches (exhaust puff, the van shakes)

T_TAP.what: the tip taps the creeping box back

T_HOOK.what: the tip hooks the door handle

T_SIP.what: sip: up, at the mouth, leaves the mouth, down

shots.name: Handbag
shots.summary: A stolen bag catches on the level shaft and slides back to its owner.

T_HOOK.what: its handle catches on the shaft

T_LOSE.what: his grip fails; he stumbles on

T_SLIDE.what: the bag slides down the shaft

T_SIP.what: sip: up, at the mouth, leaves the mouth, down

shots.name: Taxi
shots.summary: The open umbrella takes a taxi's puddle splash for two women, and the run-off rinses his trousers clean.

T_HOLD.what: the sheet of water stands up

T_SIP.what: first sip: up, at the mouth, leaves the mouth, down

T_SIP2.what: second sip (half way down at the cut)

T_CLAPS.what: the relieved bystander starts clapping (a clap every 0.262 s)

shots.name: Raindrop
shots.summary: The first drop of rain lands in his coffee's sip hole.

T1.what: the drop falls, tracked, into the sip hole (the crown jumps at the end)

T_BEADS.what: the next drops bead on the lid

shots.name: Face
shots.summary: A drop on the cheek, a look up, a smile.

T_HIT.what: the drop lands on his cheekbone

shots.name: Stance
shots.summary: The rain comes on; his fencer's lunge pops a woman's stuck umbrella open.

T_POP.what: the tip pops the catch: the red umbrella springs open

shots.name: Exit
shots.summary: He finally opens his own umbrella and walks off.

T_OPEN.what: a slow, proper open: starts, slides, springs taut (overshoot), settles

T_SIP.what: sip: up, at the mouth, leaves the mouth, down

shots.name: Last word
shots.summary: The pigeon picks the wrong target: the cat.

T_POOP.what: the dropping falls onto the cat

T_LAND.what: the pigeon lands on a branch to gloat

T_POUNCE.what: pounces: the pigeon just gets away
